objective: Measure whether the final frozen known-class generator converts altered nonlocal spatial occlusion into a corresponding change of completion-group torsional coordinate correction.

model.precision: FP32 eval no_grad; frozen weights; no optimization

data.split_policy: Scan all source records. Analyze all eligible fragments under fixed rules, with train/eval/test and distinct scaffold counts shown separately. The test set is reused post-hoc, not a new blinded sample.

eligibility: At least2 missing atoms; retained coordinates and fixed local core define a noncollinear frame.
Exactly1 retained-missing boundary, an acyclic single bond allowing completion-group rotation; source full graph sanitizes on a fresh copy.
Exclude conjugated, amide/ester-like constrained boundary bonds and constrained known branch axes.
At least1 missing heavy atom more than0.3A away from the completion rotation axis.
Original model anchor marker equals actual reference assessment boundary; known internal adjacency binds to original data.
Known branch rotation leaves the boundary and its retained graph-distance<=2 core unchanged; moving side is entirely retained atoms and has an off-axis heavy atom.

geometric_intervention.B_candidates: All eligible retained branch axes with twelve fixed30degree rotations, including the reference0degree state for accounting.
geometric_intervention.completion_probe: The same reference-derived missing-group identity/internal geometry in A and B, rotated through24 fixed15degree torsions around the retained-missing bond. This is a fixed-composition mechanism probe, not a native retrosynthesis prediction.
geometric_intervention.known_plausibility: For known-known graph-distance>2 heavy pairs, minimum distance/(vdW radii sum)>=0.65 and mean squared overlap_B<=overlap_A+0.002. Core coordinates and all retained bond lengths/angles remain unchanged within numerical tolerance.
geometric_intervention.steric_readout: C(theta)=sum over eligible retained-missing heavy pairs(graph distance>2) of max(0,1-d/(Ri+Rj))^2, divided by number of missing heavy atoms. Internal missing geometry is invariant under the probe rotation.
geometric_intervention.primary_flip_probe: g_A*g_B<0; min(abs(g_A),abs(g_B))>=0.001/radian; retained-missing nonbonded minimum distance/(Ri+Rj)>=0.55 in both conditions.
geometric_intervention.pair_selection: Within each fragment choose B by maximum eligible flip-angle count, then sum of minimum absolute gradients, then minimum absolute branch rotation, then lexicographic atom-axis order. No model output is used to select pairs.
geometric_intervention.geometry_sensitivities: Also retain all-angle masks at gradient cutoffs0.0001 and0.01; do not switch primary cutoff after model responses are read.
geometric_intervention.energy_scope: Geometrically screened interventions. Do not label low-energy or force-field validated unless an explicit separate energy calculation succeeds.

controlled_forward.schedule_mapping: Use the frozen model normalization and noise schedule to select nearest supported t to the requested physical sigma/alpha. Save achieved values and deterministic tie rule before reading responses.
controlled_forward.process: Normalize as in the original model; known coordinates/elements are clamped; add noise only to missing nodes; call the original scoped known-class conditional denoiser; recover clean coordinates before any bond/SMILES decoding.

readouts.torsional_correction: Project predicted clean-coordinate displacement from the clean completion probe onto the legal rotation tangent; save signed delta_phi in degrees, tangent-fit residual, radial drift, full boundary/internal distance and angle errors.
readouts.primary_paired_response: R=sign(g_B-g_A)*(delta_phi_B-delta_phi_A). First average over qualified flip angles and paired noise seeds within fragment at primary noise level, then aggregate fragments with equal weight. Positive R is a geometry-consistent change of angular correction.
readouts.secondary_actual_direction_flip: Both delta_phi_A*g_A and delta_phi_B*g_B positive and each abs(delta_phi)>=0.5degree. Also show thresholds0 and2degrees as prespecified sensitivities.
readouts.secondary_spatial_change: Measure nonbonded overlap before/after predicted coordinate correction and after legal-torsion projection; report boundary geometry and radial drift together, including unfavorable changes.
readouts.auxiliary_denoising_errors: Coordinate and element noise-prediction errors separately. These are denoising compatibility diagnostics, not calibrated probabilities, forces or molecular energies.

controls: Identical A repeated at the same t/noise gives the same output within documented FP32 tolerance.
Common rigid rotation/translation of scaffold, probe and coordinate noise; transform output back and compare invariance/equivariance.
Preserve paired identity/class/prior/size/local core checks for every intervention.
Geometric A/B label permutation supplies a response-association null; model outputs themselves remain unchanged.
aggregation: Report fragment/reaction/distinct known-scaffold counts, not just the large number of angle/time/noise probes. Cluster uncertainty by the preserved known-scaffold-plus-boundary identity within each split; do not treat repeated probes as independent molecules. Keep nonfinite outputs and geometry failures in coverage accounting.
visualization: Use real coordinates and measured arrays only. Publication-style blue/orange/gray, consistent local frames, all-eligible paired-response distributions, angle-resolved heatmaps and a clearly identified real structural example. Select displayed representative examples by geometry/structural rules before model response, or explicitly label outcome-ranked galleries separately. Export PNG/SVG/PDF and underlying plotted data.
interpretation: A diagnostic of the frozen model's spatial-compatibility response for precursor completion-group conformations. It does not change existing official scores or provide a new physical reaction trajectory.

amendment_before_full_mechanistic_respon.reason: After exhaustive geometry-only screening identified3113 eligible completion rotors and208 strict paired interventions, add all3113 baseline-A torsional scans to display the complete eligible cohort. No mechanistic A/B response has been inspected when making this amendment.
amendment_before_full_mechanistic_respon.baseline_A: train2465/eval331/test317 fragments,24 angles x3 fixed seeds x3 fixed noise levels =672408 model states. Static angular agreement is descriptive and remains separate from the strict paired intervention.
amendment_before_full_mechanistic_respon.strict_AB_unchanged: train154/eval16/test38 pairs. Reuse their baseline A states; add208 x24 x3 x3 =44928 B states. Strict geometry selection and primary held-out test analysis are unchanged. Total717336 unique forward states.
amendment_before_full_mechanistic_respon.computation: Original FP32 CUDA denoiser with TF32 disabled, no_grad, no optimization. Full run uses original nondeterministic aggregation for throughput. Documented identical-input, batch and equivariance tolerances are1e-5A; retain fixed-subset deterministic sensitivity. No altered timestep or replacement noise after a failed state. Record nonfinite states in full coverage.
amendment_before_full_mechanistic_respon.representatives: Retain actual predicted coordinates for20 strict test structures selected by evenly spaced sorted original row indices before reading model responses.
amendment_before_full_mechanistic_respon.selection_rule: All split/time states are executed independent of effect direction; repeated angle/noise/time probes are not independent molecules.
